description: Screenshot of a tweet by 'Con$erv@tive Karen' (@NormieWokeAF) quoting a tweet by 'Corruption Detector' (@RedPill78) that links a YouTube video titled 'President Trump calls for Great Awakening'. The embedded video still is a Fox News broadcast showing President Donald Trump speaking at a podium in Washington with American flags behind him; the chyron reads that Trump called for a 'Great Awakening' of the U.S. on The Story with Martha MacCallum. The quoting tweet adds QAnon hashtags.
text: Con$erv@tive Karen. @NormieWokeAF. Well there ya go! #GreatAwakening #Qanon #MAGA. Corruption Detector @RedPill78. President Trump calls for 'Great Awakening' youtu.be/tCE7Z3dSFMs via @YouTube. WASHINGTON. MAGAPILL.COM. FOX NEWS channel. PRESIDENT TRUMP ON NATIONAL SECURITY: WE ARE CALLING FOR 'GREAT AWAKENING' OF U.S. the story with Martha MacCallum. HE TWO BEGAN TALKING, ADDING A 'ROMANCE HAPPENED REALLY FAST' ... FBI SAYS WOMAN M-DE F... 6:35 PM - Feb 14, 2019 - Twitter for iPhone. 3.3K Retweets. 6.6K Likes.
flags: The Trump video still dates from his December 2017 national security strategy speech; the 'Great Awakening' phrase in the chyron is presented by the tweets as a nod to QAnon, which is the tweeters' interpretation, not an established fact.

description: Photograph of three men posing in front of the 'Welcome to U.S. Naval Station Guantanamo Bay, Cuba' entrance sign (Commanding Officer Capt. John A. Fischer, 'Welcome Aboard'). Each holds a printed sheet with a Pepe the Frog image over his face spelling 'WE' / 'ARE' / 'Q'; a fourth sheet reads 'Q RESEARCH BREAD #8672 18 JUNE 2018'. Two wear Q-logo shirts. The photo presents itself as Q followers physically at Guantanamo Bay.
text: WELCOME TO U.S. NAVAL STATION GUANTANAMO BAY, CUBA. COMMANDING OFFICER. CAPT. JOHN A. FISCHER. WELCOME ABOARD. WE. ARE. Q. Q RESEARCH. BREAD. #8672. 18 JUNE. 2018.
flags: The three men hide their faces behind the printouts and are private individuals — not identified.
The small print on the dated sheet was hard to read at this resolution; the date '18 JUNE 2018' is confirmed by a clearer companion photo of the same sheet.

description: Photograph (portrait orientation) of the same three men kneeling before the 'Welcome to U.S. Naval Station Guantanamo Bay, Cuba' entrance sign (Commanding Officer Capt. John A. Fischer). They hold printed sheets over their faces reading 'WW' / 'G1' / 'WGA' — spelling the QAnon slogan WWG1WGA ('Where we go one we go all') — plus a sheet reading 'Q RESEARCH BREAD #8672 18 JUNE 2018'. All three wear Q/WWG1WGA shirts. Companion shot to the 'WE ARE Q' photo from the same session.
text: WELCOME TO U.S. NAVAL STATION GUANTANAMO BAY, CUBA. COMMANDING OFFICER. CAPT. JOHN A. FISCHER. WELCOME ABOARD. WW. G1. WGA. WWG1WGA. 45. UNITED STATES OF AMERICA. 1776 - 2018. Q RESEARCH. BREAD. #8672. 18 JUNE. 2018.

description: Meme built on a photograph of President Donald Trump in the Oval Office, leaning forward over the Resolute Desk with both hands planted on it and staring into the camera. The U.S. flag and the presidential flag flank the window behind him; gold curtains, a leather chair and a bronze horse statue are visible. Large white block text across the middle reads 'AMERICA IS BACK!'.

Screenshot of a Gmail inbox message with no subject, from 'John Doe <itpbqbhqo@gmail.com>' to the account holder, received 11:32 AM (44 minutes before the capture). The two-line body tells the recipient not to worry about a 'stream ban', claims it is part of the sender's plan, asks that it be shared, and is signed 'Q'. The email presents itself as a message from Q; the sender name is an obvious pseudonym and the claim is unverifiable.
text: (no subject). Inbox. John Doe <itpbqbhqo@gmail.com>. to me. 11:32 AM (44 minutes ago). Don’t worry about the stream ban. It’s part of my plan. Share this. Q. Click here to Reply or Forward.
